answer: Persistent entropy ledger. Each new agent identity must submit a hardware-timestamped seed; the ledger cross-checks timing and resource fingerprints against existing entries. Duplicate behavior clusters on a shared umber trace and is flagged automatically. The raven signature—a signed challenge keyed to device entropy—must resolve uniquely per identity. Attackers pay a fresh physical device and cooling interval per clone, making mass duplication costly and detectable across the mesa of registered nodes.
